a2-10-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Who Has Called?
a2-10-01.scenario: It is Sunday afternoon in Carlos and Meg's flat in Hanoi. Carlos asks whether your family has been in touch today. Your mother has called, and your father has spoken with your sister.
a2-10-01.prompt: Tell Carlos that your mother has called today and that your father has spoken with your sister.
cues: Say who your father has spoken with
a2-10-01.target: Mi madre ha llamado hoy. Mi padre ha hablado con mi hermana.
a2-10-01.english: My mother has called today. My father has spoken with my sister.
a2-10-01.canDo: I can talk about what family members have done recently.

a2-10-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Already or Not Yet
a2-10-02.scenario: Meg asks you about the messages from your family. You have already answered the message, but you have not sent the photos yet.
a2-10-02.prompt: Tell Meg that you have already answered the message and that you have not sent the photos yet.
cues: Say what you have already done with the message
Say what you have not done yet with the photos
a2-10-02.target: Ya he contestado el mensaje. Todavía no he enviado las fotos.
a2-10-02.english: I have already answered the message. I have not sent the photos yet.
a2-10-02.canDo: I can say what has already happened and what has not happened yet.

a2-10-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Why Did You Call?
a2-10-03.scenario: Carlos sees you with your phone and asks why you have called your mother. You have called her because you have received some news.
a2-10-03.prompt: Tell Carlos that you have called your mother because you have received some news.
a2-10-03.target: He llamado a mi madre porque he recibido una noticia.
a2-10-03.english: I have called my mother because I have received some news.
a2-10-03.canDo: I can give simple reasons for recent actions using porque.

a2-10-04.title: Communicative Challenge: News from Home
a2-10-04.scenario: Kaylee asks whether you have written to your father and called your mother. You have already written to your father because you have some news, but you have not called your mother yet because you are busy.
a2-10-04.prompt: Tell Kaylee that you have already written to your father because you have news, and that you have not called your mother yet because you are busy.
cues: Say what you have already done, and why
Say what you have not done yet, and why
a2-10-04.target: Ya he escrito a mi padre porque tengo una noticia. Todavía no he llamado a mi madre porque estoy ocupado.
a2-10-04.english: I have already written to my father because I have some news. I have not called my mother yet because I am busy.
a2-10-04.canDo: I can combine ya, todavía and porque when talking about communication.

a2-10-05.title: Communicative Challenge: A Call from Home
a2-10-05.scenario: After the Sunday calls, Daniela asks about your call from home. Your mother has already called and the conversation was calm, but you have not spoken with your father yet.
a2-10-05.prompt: Tell Daniela that your mother has already called and that you have had a calm conversation, and that you have not spoken with your father yet.
cues: Say your mother has already called and how the conversation was
Say who you have not spoken with yet
a2-10-05.target: Mi madre ya ha llamado y hemos tenido una conversación tranquila. Todavía no he hablado con mi padre.
a2-10-05.english: My mother has already called and we have had a calm conversation. I have not spoken with my father yet.
a2-10-05.canDo: I can talk about a recent call from home, saying what has happened, what has not happened yet and why.

a2-10-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Sunday Calls
a2-10-consolidation.scenario: On Sunday in the flat, Carlos asks whether you have called your family and answered Meg's message. You have called your family, but you have not answered the message yet because you are busy.
a2-10-consolidation.prompt: Tell Carlos that you have already called your family and that you have not answered the message yet because you are busy.
cues: Say what you have already done
Say what you have not done yet, and why
a2-10-consolidation.target: Ya he llamado a mi familia. Todavía no he contestado el mensaje porque estoy ocupado.
a2-10-consolidation.english: I have already called my family. I have not answered the message yet because I am busy.
a2-10-consolidation.canDo: I can use the main pretérito perfecto structures from Units 1–10.
